KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:37:50/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:37:50/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:37:50/r1.claim: This representative dialogue among Paradise’s people compares two kinds of people: those who believed in the afterlife and lived responsibly will see their belief vindicated and be rewarded in Paradise, while those who denied it and lived without ultimate responsibility face Hell’s misery.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:37:50/r1.anchor: Tahtlar üzerinde karşılıklı oturan (44. âyet) cennet ehlinden bir grup arasındaki konuşmalardan bir kesit veren temsilî bir anlatım olup iki insan tipi, dolayısıyla iki inanç grubunun âkıbetleri arasında bir karşılaştırma yapılmakta

BURSEVI:v7p359#3/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p359#3/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p359#3/r11.claim: The speaker sees his companion in the middle of Hell; its center is called sawāʾ because it is equally distant from every side.
BURSEVI:v7p359#3/r11.anchor: وسمي وسط الشيء سواء لاستواء المسافة منه إلى جميع الجوانب

NAHHAS:v3p421/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p421/r10.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p421/r10.claim: فأطلع can be a future verb, meaning that I will look, made subjunctive as a response to the question.
NAHHAS:v3p421/r10.anchor: أحدهما أن يكون فعلا مستقبلا أي فأطلع أنا ويكون منصوبا على أنه جواب الاستفهام

NAHHAS:v3p421/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p421/r11.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p421/r11.claim: Alternatively, فأطلع is past tense, with أطلع and اطّلع treated as equivalent.
NAHHAS:v3p421/r11.anchor: والقول الثاني على أن يكون فعلا ماضيا ويكون أطلع واطلع واحدا

NAHHAS:v3p421/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p421/r12.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
NAHHAS:v3p421/r12.claim: Ibn Masud explains the middle of Hell as its center, with thorns surrounding it.
NAHHAS:v3p421/r12.anchor: عن عبد الله بن مسعود قال في وسطها والحسك حواليه

MUQATIL:37:51-56/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:37:51-56/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:37:51-56/r5.claim: The believer sees his brother in Hell’s middle, with a black face, blue eyes, and chained to his satanic companion, and says that companion nearly led him astray.
MUQATIL:37:51-56/r5.anchor: يعنى فى وسط { الجحيم } [آية: 55] أسود الوجه أزرق العينين مقرونا مع شيطانه فى سلسلة

TABATABAI:37:50-59/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:37:50-59/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:37:50-59/r6.claim: Sawāʾ means the middle, as in the middle of a road; the speaker looks into Hell and sees his companion in its center.
TABATABAI:37:50-59/r6.anchor: السواء الوسط ومنه سواء الطريق أي وسطه والمعنى فأشرف القائل المذكور على النار فرآه أي قرينه في وسط الجحيم.

SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r2.claim: سواء الجحيم means its middle; Ibn Abbas's explanation is that distance from it to every side is equal.
SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r2.anchor: وسواء الجحيم وسطها. وأحسن ما قيل فيه ما قاله ابن عباس: سمي بذلك لاستواء المسافة منه إلى الجوانب.

SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r3.speaker: عيسى بن عمر
SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r3.claim: Isa ibn Umar told Abu Ubayda that he wrote until his سوائي gave out, using the word for the body's middle or back.
SAMIN-DURR:37:55/r3.anchor: وعن عيسى بن عمر أنه قال لأبي عبيدة: " كنت أكتب حتى ينقطع سوائي ".

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets sawāʾ al-jaḥīm as the middle of Hell, and a cited Arabic verse supports the expression for a central place.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r1.anchor: فقال ابن عباس: في وسط الجحيم. سأله ابن الأزرق: وهل كانت العرب تعرف ذلك؟ قال: نعم

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r2.claim: Bint al-Shati derives the sense from a midpoint between endpoints: physical equality extends figuratively to a balanced word in 3:64 and to two alternatives being equal in 2:6.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r2.anchor: وتفسير الكلمة في آية الصافات بالوسط، قريب من أصل دلالة الكلمة على الموضع الوسَط بين الأطراف

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r3.speaker: الراغب
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r3.claim: Al-Raghib also interprets the phrase as the middle of Hell, describing a place whose two ends are equal and noting adjectival and adverbial use.

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r4.speaker: الفراء
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r4.claim: Al-Farra likewise explains the phrase as the middle of Hell.

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r5.speaker: الأصمعي، وابن السكيت، وابن الأنباري
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r5.claim: Al-Asma'i, Ibn al-Sikkit, and Ibn al-Anbari also discuss sawāʾ in their works on antonyms.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p454/r5.anchor: والأصمعي وابن السكيت وابن الأنباري، في (الأضداد) لهم

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r1.speaker: القراء كلهم
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r1.claim: All readers have the common sequence مطلعون فاطلع, except for a transmitted reading from Abū ʿAmr described next.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r1.anchor: قال: وكلهم قرأ: مطلعون. فاطلع [الصافات/ 54، 55] إلا أن ابن حيان أخبرنا عن أبي هشام

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r2.speaker: أبو عمرو
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r2.claim: A transmission from Abū ʿAmr reads هل أنتم مطلعون followed by فأطلع, with the source specifying its vowel pattern.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r2.anchor: عن أبي عمرو أنه قرأ هل أنتم مطلعون. فأطلع الألف مضمومة، والطاء ساكنة

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r3.speaker: أبو الحسن
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r3.claim: Abū al-Ḥasan says the doubled form مطلعون is more common in Arabic, and افتعلت is more frequent than أطلعت, though both are Arabic.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r3.anchor: قال أبو الحسن: مطلعون مثقلة أكثر في كلام العرب، وقال: واطلعت- افتعلت- أكثر من أطلعت

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r4.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r4.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r4.claim: Al-Fārisī understands هل أنتم مطلعون as asking whether they will show him the companion so he can look; he illustrates the causative with طلع زيد وأطلعه غيره.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p55#2/r4.anchor: قال أبو علي: المعنى في هل أنتم مطلعون: هل أنتم مطلعي فأطلع. تقديره: أفعل، تقول: طلع زيد

IBNMUJAHID:v1p547/r3.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p547/r3.speaker: أبو عمرو
IBNMUJAHID:v1p547/r3.claim: All read the phrase except for a reported Abū ʿAmr form with ḍamma on the initial alif, a still tāʾ, kasra on lām, and fatḥa on ʿayn.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p547/r3.anchor: إلا أن ابن حيان أخبرنا عن أبى هشام عن حسين الجعفى عن أبى عمرو أنه قرأ ﴿ هل أنتم مطلعون فاطلع ﴾ الألف مضمومة والطاء ساكنة واللام مكسورة والعين مفتوحة

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p149#2/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p149#2/r1.speaker: خليد العصري
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p149#2/r1.claim: Khulayid al-Asri says the man saw his former companion in the middle of Hell, with skulls boiling; he would not have recognized him without God’s identification because his appearance had changed.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p149#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة عن خليد العصري في قوله تعالى ﴿ فاطلع فرآه في سواء الجحيم ﴾ قال في وسطها قال رأى جماجمهم تغلي

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r1.claim: The speaker looked toward the people of Hell and saw his companion there.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r1.anchor: ( فاطلع ( أي على أهل النار ( فرآه ( أي فرأى قرينه ( في سواء الجحيم

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r2.claim: Sawāʾ means the middle, since the distance from the center to the surrounding sides is equal; ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar uses the word for one's middle in an expression to Abū ʿUbayda.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r2.anchor: أي في وسطها ومنه قول عيسى بن عمر لأبي عبيدة كنت أكتب حتى ينقطع سوائي

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r3.speaker: أبو عمرو وابن عباس وابن محيصن وعمار بن أبي عمار وأبو سراج
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r3.claim: In Ḥusayn al-Jaʿfī's transmission, Abū ʿAmr reads the preceding 'those looking' with ṭāʾ still and nūn fatḥa; Ibn ʿAbbās, Ibn Muḥayṣin, ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār, and Abū Sirāj read fa-uṭṭuliʿa as a passive past verb.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r3.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو في رواية حسين الجعفي ( مطلعون ) بإسكان الطاء وفتح النون ( فاطلع ) بضم الهمزة وسكون الطاء وكسر اللام فعلا ماضيا مبنيا للمفعول

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r5.speaker: أبو البرهسم وعمار ابن أبي عمار
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r5.claim: Abū al-Barahsim and, in Khalaf's report, ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār read the first word lightly with kasra on nūn, followed by a passive past verb.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92/r5.anchor: بتخفيف الطاء وكسر النون ( فاطلع ) ماضيا مبنيا للمفعول

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r6.claim: Ṭalaʿa and the forms with doubled or light hamza mean the same, generally intransitively; aʾṭlaʿa can also be transitive in the sense of showing someone something.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r6.anchor: وطلع واطلع بالتشديد وأطلع بالتخفيف بمعنى واحد والكل لازم ويجيء الإطلاع متعديا يقال أطلعه على كذا فأطلع

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r7.claim: In Abū ʿAmr's reading, muṭṭaliʿūn means 'those who will show'; the interlocutors are the agents, and their agreement to look first becomes the means by which the speaker is shown the scene.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r7.anchor: بمعنى مطلعون بالتشديد ونائب فاعل أطلع ضمير القائل والفاعل هم المخاطبون

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r8.claim: The question is a courteous, emphatic request; the fa-clause explains omitted wording, with an understood sequence in which they look and then he looks too.

ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r9.speaker: صاحب اللوامح
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r9.claim: The author of al-Lawāmiḥ says ṭalaʿa and aṭlaʿa can mean to come or arrive; on the passive reading he suggests an omitted source or prepositional phrase, but Abū Ḥayyān objects that a passive subject cannot be omitted.
ALUSI-FULL:v23p92#2/r9.anchor: وعن صاحب اللوامح أن طلع واطلع إطلاعا بمعنى أقبل وجاء والقائم مقام الفاعل على قراءة أطلع مبنيا للمفعول

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says Paradise has openings through which its inhabitants look into the Fire, and this believer looked through one.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r5.anchor: قال ابن عباس: إن في الجنة كوى ينظر أهلها منها إلى النار

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r6.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r6.claim: He saw his companion in the middle of the Fire; its middle is called sawāʾ because its sides are equal.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p41#2/r6.anchor: فرأى قرينه في وسط النار، وإنما سمي وسط الشيء سواء لاستواء الجوانب منه.

BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r2.claim: The person seen is the speaker’s companion.
BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r2.anchor: { فرءاه } أي قرينه. { فى سواء الجحيم }

BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r3.claim: The companion was in Hell’s middle.
BAYDAWI-FULL:37:55-59/r3.anchor: أي قرينه. { فى سواء الجحيم } وسطه.

BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r1.claim: The singular is kept for the speaker because the account concerns the saved man's rebuke and self-congratulation; a plural would wrongly suggest that everyone spoke, so his words can instruct the reader.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r1.anchor: لم يجمع الضمير لئلا يلبس فيوهم أنه للجميع

BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r2.claim: The middle of Hell is called its sawāʾ because it is equidistant from the surrounding sides, like the center of a circle.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p313/r2.anchor: وسمي الوسط سواء لاستواء المسافة منه إلى الجوانب كمركز الدائرة

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses the middle of Hell as its center.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما في قوله : سواء الجحيم قال : وسط الجحيم

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r2.speaker: كعب الأحبار
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r2.claim: Ka'b al-Ahbar says there are windows in Paradise through which its inhabitants can look at an enemy in the Fire and increase in gratitude; Qatada transmits the report.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3216/r2.anchor: في الجنة كوى . فاذا اراد أحد من اهلها ان ينظر إلى عدوه في النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r1.claim: The unexpressed complement of مطلعون is understood from the final phrase: are you looking at the people of Hell so we can inspect them?
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r1.anchor: فالتقدير : هل أنتم مطلعون على أهل النار لننظره فيهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r2.claim: The wording compresses the scene: the speaker and companions looked and saw the companion in Hell’s center, but only his own viewing is stated because he looked first to identify him for the others.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r2.anchor: اكتفاء ، أي فاطلع واطلعوا فرآه ورأوه في سواء الجحيم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v23p117/r3.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of Hell; Balʿāʾ ibn Qays’s line uses sawāʾ for the middle of the head.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r7.speaker: جمهور القراء
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r7.claim: Most readers pronounce faṭṭalaʿa with a connecting alif and doubled, open ṭāʾ.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r7.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور «فاطلع» بصلة الألف وشد الطاء المفتوحة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r8.speaker: أبو عمرو في رواية حسين وأبو البرهسم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r8.claim: In Ḥusayn's transmission, Abū ʿAmr and Abū al-Barahsam read with a hamza of pronunciation, quiescent ṭāʾ, and kasra on lām; al-Zajjāj says this fits the reading of muṭṭaliʿūn with kasra on lām.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r8.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو في رواية حسين «فاطلع» بضم الألف وسكون الطاء وكسر اللام، وهي قراءة أبي البرهسم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r9.speaker: الرماني عن أبي علي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r9.claim: A report says Paradise's inhabitants have windows and openings from which they can look at Hell, taking pleasure and comfort in the punishment as a lesson and retribution.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r9.anchor: وروي أن لأهل الجنة كوى وطاقات يشرفون منها على أهل النار إذا شاؤوا على جهة النقمة والعبرة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r10.speaker: ابن عباس والحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Ḥasan say sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of Hell, called sawāʾ because the distance to each side is equal.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r10.anchor: وسواء الجحيم وسطه قال ابن عباس والحسن: والناس، وسمي سواء لاستواء المسافة منه إلى الجوانب

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r11.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r11.claim: Jaḥīm is a mass of piled-up fire embers.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r12.speaker: مطرف بن عبد الله وخليد العصري
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r12.claim: Muṭarrif ibn ʿAbd Allāh and Khulayḍ al-ʿAṣrī report that the former companion's appearance and condition had changed so much that the believer would not have recognized him without being shown who he was.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p474/r12.anchor: وروي عن مطرف بن عبد الله وخليد العصري أنه رآه قد تغير خبره وسيره أي تبدلت حاله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r1.claim: He sees his unbelieving companion in the middle of Hell.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r1.anchor: ﴿ فرآه ﴾ يعني قرينة الكافر ﴿ في سواء الجحيم ﴾ أي في وسطها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r2.speaker: قول غير مسمى
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r2.claim: One explanation calls the center sawāʾ because it is equally distant from every side.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r2.anchor: وقيل إنما سمي الوسط سواء لاستواء المسافة منه إلى الجوانب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r3.speaker: خليد العصري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r3.claim: Khālid al-ʿAṣrī says the believer would not have recognized the companion if God had not identified him, since his color and appearance had changed.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p60#3/r3.anchor: قال خليد العصري والله لولا أن الله عرفه إياه ما عرفه لقد تغير حبره وسبره

NASAFI-FULL:v4p21#5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p21#5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p21#5/r1.claim: The believer looks and sees his companion in the very middle of Hell.

QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r3.speaker: النحاس
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r3.claim: Al-Nahhas gives two parses for fa-aṭṭalaʿa: a subjunctive present meaning “so I may look,” answering the question, or a past verb synonymous with iṭṭalaʿa.
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r3.anchor: النحاس: «فأطلع فرآه» فيه قولان: أحدهما أن يكون فعلا مستقبلا معناه فأطلع أنا

QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r4.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r4.claim: Al-Zajjaj says ṭalaʿa, aṭlaʿa, and iṭṭalaʿa all have the same meaning.
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-55/r4.anchor: قال الزجاج: يقال طلع وأطلع واطلع بمعنى واحد

QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r4.claim: The companion is seen in the middle of Hell, with thorns around him; Ibn Masud is cited for the thorns.
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r4.anchor: أي في وسط النار والحسك حواليه قاله ابن مسعود

QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r5.speaker: أبو عبيدة
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r5.claim: Abu Ubayda explains sawāʾ as the middle, recalling Isa ibn Umar’s idiom about writing until his middle gave out.
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r5.anchor: وعن أبي عبيدة: قال لي عيسى بن عمر: كنت أكتب يا أبا عبيدة حتى ينقطع سوائي

QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r6.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r6.claim: Qatada transmits the view of some scholars that without God identifying the companion, he would not have recognized him because his appearance had changed.
QURTUBI-FULL:37:54-59/r6.anchor: وعن قتادة قال قال بعض العلماء: لولا أن الله جل وعز عرفه إياه لما عرفه، لقد تغير حبره

STUDYQURAN:37:54/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:37:54/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:37:54/r2.claim: The believer sees his worldly companion in Hell and realizes he would have shared his fate had he followed him; God’s guidance saved him.
STUDYQURAN:37:54/r2.anchor: had he followed him, he would have suffered the same fate and that if not for God’s Blessing in guiding him

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r1.claim: The speaker looks into Hell and sees his former companion in the very middle of its Fire.

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r2.claim: The account omits the interlocutors' reply, understood from the context as their saying, “Yes.”
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r2.anchor: سأل ربه أن يطلعه، قال {فاطلع فرآه في سواء الجحيم}

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains “the middle of Hell.”
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r3.anchor: ابن عباس، قوله: {في سواء الجحيم} [الصافات: 55] يعني: «في وسط الجحيم»

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r4.speaker: الحسن
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r4.claim: Al-Ḥasan likewise takes the phrase to mean the middle of Hell.
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r4.anchor: الحسن، في قوله: {في سواء الجحيم} [الصافات: 55] يقول: «في وسط الجحيم»

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r5.claim: Qatāda says “the middle of it,” referring to Hell.
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r5.anchor: قتادة، في قوله: {سواء الجحيم} [الصافات: 55] قال: وسطها

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r6.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r6.claim: Qatāda says the speaker asked God to let him look, then saw his companion in Hell's middle.
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r6.anchor: عن قتادة، قال: {هل أنتم مطلعون} [الصافات: 54] قال:

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r7.speaker: خليد العصري
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r7.claim: Khalīd al-ʿAṣrī says God had to identify the man, since Fire had altered his appearance; the speaker saw the people's skulls.
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r7.anchor: عن قتادة، عن خليد العصري، قال: " لولا أن الله عرفه إياه ما عرفه، لقد تغير حبره وسبره بعده، وذكر لنا أنه اطلع فرأى جماجم القوم

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r8.speaker: مطرف بن عبد الله
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r8.claim: Muṭarrif ibn ʿAbd Allāh says the man would not have been recognized otherwise because the Fire had changed his appearance.
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r8.anchor: عن مطرف بن عبد الله، في قوله: {فاطلع فرآه في سواء الجحيم} [الصافات: 55] قال: «والله لولا أنه عرفه ما عرفه، لقد غيرت النار حبره وسبره»

TAB-FULL:v19p547/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r9.claim: Al-Suddī reports that Ibn ʿAbbās read the question with the object suffix: “هل أنتم مطلعوني.”
TAB-FULL:v19p547/r9.anchor: ابن عباس يقرؤها: (هل أنتم مطلعوني فاطلع فرآه في سواء الجحيم)

SULAMI:v2p177#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p177#2/r1.speaker: القاسم
SULAMI:v2p177#2/r1.claim: There are two kinds of seeing: the elect’s, marked by modesty and abiding life, and the lowly one’s, marked by extinction and ruin.
SULAMI:v2p177#2/r1.anchor: قال القاسم : الاطلاع اطلاعان : اطلاع التخصيص فيه الحياء والبقاء

SULAMI:v2p177#2/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p177#2/r2.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p177#2/r2.claim: Seeing his likenesses in Hell, the observer understands that deeds did not save him; only his Lord’s grace did.
SULAMI:v2p177#2/r2.anchor: قال بعضهم : اطلع في النار فرأى امثاله فيها واشكاله

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r1.claim: The shortened forms سوى and سوى mean “other than”; both can function as a substitute, and the word is ordinarily shortened.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r1.anchor: سوى وسوى: بمعنى غير، وهما جميعا في معنى بدل. وهي مقصورة.

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r2.speaker: ذو الرمة
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r2.claim: Dhu al-Rumma’s usage of سواء witnesses the elongated, open-initial form meaning “other than.”
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r2.anchor: قال ذو الرمة : وما تجافى الغيت عنه فما به ... سواء الحمام الحضن الخضر حاضر

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r3.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r3.claim: The long form سواء, with an open first syllable, means “middle” in «في سواء الجحيم».
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p278#3/r3.anchor: وسواء- مفتوحة الأول ممدود- بمعنى: وسط. قال: فاطلع فرآه في سواء الجحيم (55)

ITQAN:v2p363/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p363/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p363/r1.claim: A quoted gloss takes sawāʾ al-jaḥīm as the middle of Hell and adduces a poetic line as evidence for the sense middle.
ITQAN:v2p363/r1.anchor: قال أخبرني عن قوله تعالى ﴿ في سواء الجحيم ﴾ قال وسط الجحيم أما سمعت قول الشاعر

ITQAN:v2p475#2/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r1.claim: Sawāʾ meaning equal is shortened with kasra or lengthened with fatḥa, as the cited Qur'anic examples show.
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r1.anchor: تكون بمعنى مستو فتقصر مع الكسر نحو ﴿ مكانا سوى ﴾ وتمد مع الفتح نحو

ITQAN:v2p475#2/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r2.claim: When lengthened with fatḥa, sawāʾ can mean the middle, as in 37:55, or completeness, as in the cited four-day phrase.
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r2.anchor: وبمعنى الوسط فيمد مع الفتح نحو ﴿ في سواء الجحيم ﴾ وبمعنى التمام فكذلك نحو ﴿ في أربعة أيام سواء ﴾ أي تماما

ITQAN:v2p475#2/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r3.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r3.claim: The author says sawāʾ is not used in the Qur'an to mean other; al-Burhan's proposed example in فقد ضل سواء السبيل is mistaken.
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r3.anchor: ولم ترد في القرآن بمعنى غير وقيل وردت وجعل منه في البرهان ﴿ فقد ضل سواء السبيل ﴾ وهو وهم

ITQAN:v2p475#2/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r4.claim: Al-Kalbi's view that سوى in ولا أنت مكانا سوى is exceptive with an omitted object is preferable to al-Burhan's example, but Suyuti calls it remote because سوى is not used unannexed.
ITQAN:v2p475#2/r4.anchor: وأحسن منه قول الكلبي في قوله تعالى ﴿ ولا أنت مكانا سوى ﴾ إنها استثنائية والمستثنى محذوف أي مكانا سوى هذا المكان حكاه الكرماني في عجائبه قال وفيه بعد لأنها لا تستعمل غير مضافة

DAMGHANI:v1p251/r7.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p251/r7.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p251/r7.claim: Sawāʾ means the middle: the speaker sees his companion in the middle of Hell.
DAMGHANI:v1p251/r7.anchor: الثاني : سواء يعني وسطا قوله تعالى في سورة الصافات
